coverage_override.reason: One Xyz material requirement and four separately activatable HOPT effects account for all printed clauses; the final sentence applies the HOPT to those four effects.

effects.printed_clause: 2 Level 4 "Arckcestial" monsters, including a LIGHT Synchro Monster.
effects.lua_implementation: A level-free two-material Xyz procedure requires both materials to be Level 4 Arckcestial cards and the selected group to include a LIGHT Synchro Monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Official filtered Xyz procedures validate an exact material group and special material qualification.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can send 1 "Arckcestial" monster from your Deck to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed Xyz Summon trigger checks SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ and sends one Deck Arckcestial monster able to go to the GY under the first HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official summon-triggered Deck selection effects register summon events, filter the Deck, and perform the selected movement at resolution.

effects.printed_clause: You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: An Ignition Effect removes one overlay as cost, then searches a Rank-Up-Magic Spell from the Deck and reveals it, under a distinct HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Rank-Up-Magic support uses the Rank-Up-Magic setcode and Xyz overlay-cost handling.

effects.printed_clause: If you Special Summon an "Arckcestial" Xyz or Synchro Monster(s): You can Special Summon this card from your GY in Defense Position, then you can add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your GY to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: The GY delayed field trigger now requires an event monster that was Special Summoned by this effect's controller, is Arckcestial, and is Synchro/Xyz; it revives Azeriel in Defense and optionally recovers a GY Rank-Up-Magic Spell.

official_references.matched_structure: Official 'If you Special Summon' event handling uses Card.IsSummonPlayer to distinguish who performed the summon.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: end-state control is not the summoning player. The previous IsControler check incorrectly triggered when an opponent's effect Special Summoned an Arckcestial to this player's field.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is detached from an "Arckcestial" Xyz Monster to activate that monster's effect: You can destroy 1 face-up card on the field.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_MOVE trigger verifies REASON_COST, an activated Arckcestial Xyz reason effect, and previous overlay location, then chooses and destroys one face-up card under its own HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official detached-as-cost triggers inspect REASON_COST, the reason effect, and previous overlay location.
